issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.title is a String (a Book consists of two Strings: title and author). In the solution repository the Book struct declares title as an Int (let title: Int). This mismatches the specification and also conflicts with the solution's Client code which constructs Book instances using String literals for the title. Students would be confused about the correct type to use for title and this would prevent correct compilation if they follow the solution implementation as-is.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the Book struct's title property to String (let title: String) in the solution (and ensure the template or any provided starter definitions use the same). Verify all code that constructs or uses Book.title uses String values. This will align the solution with the problem specification and remove the conflicting types that would block compilation.
